mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules (workation_id, merchant_id, scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workationId}, #{merchantId}, #{scheduledAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.sql: s.id, s.workation_id, s.merchant_id, s.scheduled_at, s.created_at, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url
mapper.select: SELECT FROM schedules s JOIN merchants m ON m.id = s.merchant_id JOIN workations w ON w.id = s.workation_id AND w.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.id = #{scheduleId}

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT DATE_ADD(#{startDate}, INTERVAL n DAY) AS item_date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 ) offsets WHERE n < #{days} ) SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'RESERVATION' AS item_type, r.id AS reservation_id, NULL AS schedule_id, m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category AS merchant_category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, r.start_date, r.end_date, NULL AS scheduled_at, d.item_date FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id JOIN date_range d ON d.item_date >= r.start_date AND d.item_date < r.end_date WHERE r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') AND rp.product_detail_type = 'ROOM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RESERVATION', r.id, NULL, m.id, m.name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, r.start_date, r.end_date, NULL, d.item_date FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id JOIN date_range d ON d.item_date >= r.start_date AND d.item_date <= r.end_date WHERE r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED') AND rp.product_detail_type <> 'ROOM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SCHEDULE', NULL, s.id, m.id, m.name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, NULL, NULL, s.scheduled_at, DATE(s.scheduled_at) FROM schedules s JOIN merchants m ON m.id = s.merchant_id JOIN date_range d ON d.item_date = DATE(s.scheduled_at) WHERE s.workation_id = #{workationId} ) items
ORDER BY items.item_date, CASE items.merchant_category WHEN 'ACCOMMODATION' THEN 0 WHEN 'OFFICE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, items.scheduled_at, items.merchant_name
